profiles.description: Software-enumerated Windows device for driver logic and interface smoke tests.
profiles.virtualization: Windows root enumerator; no QEMU hardware model is required.
QEMU xHCI and a specific emulated USB device, or carefully controlled USB passthrough.

profiles.description: Bluetooth controller, radio, or profile/function driver.
profiles.virtualization: A modeled USB/PCI HCI controller and radio/profile simulator; generic Ethernet emulation is not Bluetooth emulation.

profiles.description: Wi-Fi miniport, radio, or related device driver.
profiles.virtualization: A Wi-Fi-aware simulator or matched physical adapter passthrough; QEMU e1000e/virtio-net presents Ethernet, not 802.11.
A device-specific QEMU model or dedicated physical passthrough; QEMU's generic PCI bus does not reproduce an arbitrary function.
Attach a disposable QEMU qcow2 disk through a supported emulated controller; never test writes against a host disk.

profiles.description: Network interface or network filter driver.
profiles.virtualization: QEMU e1000e/virtio-net or a device-specific model; traffic and offload behavior require explicit test cases.

profiles.description: Robot or control-system device, often composed of multiple buses and interfaces.
profiles.virtualization: A protocol-aware simulator connected over the same bus or a test adapter; a generic VM cannot model sensors and actuators automatically.

profiles.description: Compute, AI, graphics, or other hardware accelerator.
profiles.virtualization: A vendor simulator, device-specific QEMU model, or dedicated passthrough hardware; accelerator semantics are vendor-specific.

profiles.description: A device class or bus not covered above.
profiles.virtualization: Implement a transport-specific simulator or use a controlled device passthrough.
